tickets.title: VPN disconnects during remote sessions — Chennai hub
tickets.description: VPN tunnel drops every ten minutes; office LAN remains stable. Client logs show renegotiation timeouts. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Compared gateway and client lifetimes, corrected the approved VPN profile mismatch, then verified a stable 60-minute session.

tickets.title: SSO login loops after sign-in — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Employees authenticate successfully but the expense portal redirects to the login screen. Other apps work. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Compared SAML assertion audience with the service provider configuration, corrected the audience value under change approval and verified sign-in.

tickets.title: ERP purchase orders stuck in queue — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Purchase orders remain pending and the integration worker logs retry errors. No duplicate orders observed. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Found an expired integration credential, rotated it through the approved vault process, replayed queued messages with duplicate checks and verified delivery.

tickets.title: Docking station loses external displays — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Two monitors go blank when the laptop wakes; built-in display works and cables pass swap tests. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Applied the approved dock firmware update and validated three sleep/wake cycles with both monitors.

tickets.title: Container pods repeatedly restart — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Checkout staging pods report memory limit errors after the latest release; node health is normal. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Confirmed memory exhaustion in telemetry, rolled back the faulty release with owner approval and verified pod stability.

tickets.title: Endpoint reports suspicious attachment — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Endpoint protection quarantined an attachment opened by a test user. No evidence yet of lateral movement. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Security team isolated the endpoint with approval, inspected the sample in a sandbox, removed persistence and restored access after a clean scan.

tickets.title: Branch DNS resolution fails intermittently — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Internal hostnames fail to resolve from a branch while direct IP connectivity works. Resolver timeout errors repeat. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Located an unreachable secondary DNS forwarder, corrected its routing under change approval and tested internal and external lookups.

tickets.title: MFA prompts repeat on managed laptop — Chennai hub
tickets.description: A managed laptop requests MFA on every browser refresh; the same account works on another managed device. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Confirmed incorrect device time, restored time synchronization and renewed the managed browser session; MFA then behaved normally.

tickets.title: Reporting dashboard shows stale data — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Daily revenue dashboard stopped updating although source transactions continue. The ETL job has failed since midnight. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Found a schema mismatch in the ETL mapping, deployed the reviewed mapping correction and reconciled refreshed totals against the source.

tickets.title: Office printer queues never complete — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Jobs remain in the shared print queue and local test pages print correctly. Multiple users affected. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Found a corrupt spool job, cleared only the approved affected jobs and restarted the spooler in a maintenance window; test jobs passed.

tickets.title: Object storage uploads return forbidden — Chennai hub
tickets.description: A scheduled backup can list its bucket but new uploads return access denied after a policy deployment. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Compared effective permissions with the approved baseline, restored the missing write permission at the narrow bucket scope and verified a test backup.

tickets.title: Certificate expiry warning on internal API — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Monitoring reports that the internal API TLS certificate expires within 24 hours. Clients still connect. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Renewed the certificate through the approved certificate authority, deployed the chain and verified expiry and TLS negotiation.

tickets.title: Video meetings suffer packet loss — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Calls from the training room show packet loss during afternoon sessions; wired clients perform normally. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Measured wireless channel congestion, applied an approved channel plan and validated packet loss below the agreed threshold.

tickets.title: New starter cannot access shared drive — Chennai hub
tickets.description: A provisioned user can sign in but gets access denied on the finance share; access request is approved. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Verified approved group membership had not synchronized, reran the provisioning job and validated least-privilege access.

tickets.title: Database connections exhausted — Chennai hub
tickets.description: The internal scheduling app returns 503 during a batch run. Database connection count reaches its configured ceiling. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Identified unclosed batch connections, deployed the reviewed pooling fix and verified connection counts returned to baseline.

tickets.title: Laptop battery drains while sleeping — Chennai hub
tickets.description: A laptop loses most battery overnight with the lid closed. Battery diagnostics show normal health. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Found an incompatible peripheral waking the system, applied an approved driver update and verified overnight sleep power usage.

tickets.title: CI deployment cannot pull image — Chennai hub
tickets.description: A deployment job cannot pull a container image; the tag exists and registry health is normal. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Renewed the expired registry identity through the secret manager and reran the approved deployment with digest verification.

tickets.title: Service account has unexpected permissions — Chennai hub
tickets.description: A scheduled access review flags broad permissions on a nonproduction service account. No misuse is confirmed. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Compared grants with the approved role, removed excess privileges after owner sign-off and validated required jobs still run.

tickets.title: Email calendar invitations delayed — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Meeting invitations reach mailboxes thirty minutes late while ordinary email arrives promptly. Queue metrics are elevated. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Traced delays to a stuck calendar transport worker, restarted it under change approval and verified queue recovery without duplicate invitations.

tickets.title: Load balancer marks healthy nodes down — Chennai hub
tickets.description: Health checks fail after a new path is deployed; direct requests to the application succeed. Fictional training incident; impact and resolution must be verified independently.
tickets.solution: Updated the health-check path to the reviewed application endpoint and verified all nodes passed checks before restoring traffic.
